answer: Thus, every sock puppet costs 3 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the nadir record shows exactly who is still on probation. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the summit queue naming the fable that holds the sponsor's bond. A new identity serves a probation of 3 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. That is 28 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
